The '''PCW-876''' was a model of [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutter]] manufactured by [[Borallis Metalworking & Materials]]. It had a variable cutting beam capable of cutting through most metals, [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] and [[Ceramic/Legends|ceramics]].<ref name="GFT" />
